workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free next week:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30
Let me know which of these work for Elena and David.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time that works for them from your list is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for that time. Let me know when it's done, and I'll send the confirmation email.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's ready for you to send the confirmation.

emails.body: This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled.
